definitions: A coniferous tree of the genus Cedrus in the family Pinaceae.
A coniferous tree of the family Cupressaceae, especially of the genera Juniperus, Cupressus, Calocedrus, or Thuja.

A long, broad and thick piece of timber, as opposed to a board which is less thick.
A flat piece of wood on which to cook fish, so that the wood provides flavor and helps to produce a pleasing texture.
A flat piece of wood on which to cook fish, so that the wood provides flavor and helps to produce a pleasing texture.
To bake (fish, etc.) on a piece of cedar lumber.
